content.short: Based on the first cross-chain bridge CBTC, MicroChains is committed to providing a safer and better cross-chain solution that is emerging chain friendly.
content.description:
MicroChains (previously was CBTC Bridge) carries the mission of “ The Power to Bridge More Emerging Chains”. It is committed to providing more secure cross-chain solutions to emerging chains and all public chains.

MicroChains invents the VoMEN Network security solution to greatly improve cross-chain services. VoMEN Network is the combination of multiple internal verifications and enhanced nodes network validation. Also, top Trust company HuobiTrust is invited to be the third-party supervisor to jointly prevent assets theft, over-issuance, and abuse.

Moreover, in the product V2, the cross-chain experience is as easy as swapping. Users just need to connect the wallet and then they can directly swap native assets to C-tokens of the destination chain. MicroChains will continuously work on better cross-chain experiences of web3.0 with the prerequisite of absolute security, integrating more emerging chains and empowering the interoperability of blockchain by the cross-chain bridge.
